patients.uploadDescription: Recognized columns: First Name, Last Name, Phone (required), Email, Date of Birth, Gender, Address, Blood Type. The system also recognizes Albanian column names (Emri, Mbiemri, Telefoni, etc.) and accepts .csv, .xlsx, or .xls files.

appointments.uploadTitle: Upload Appointments from CSV or Excel
appointments.uploadDescription: Recognized columns: patient's Phone (or First+Last Name), Date, Time, Doctor, Type/Service (required), Duration, Status, Notes. The patient must already exist in the system — import patients first if they're missing. The doctor is matched by staff name or email; if no match is found, the appointment is imported without an assigned doctor.

staff.uploadTitle: Upload Staff from CSV or Excel
staff.uploadDescription: Recognized columns: Name (required), Email, Phone, Role, Specialization, Hire Date. Imported staff get a temporary password — no welcome email is sent during a bulk import.

services.uploadTitle: Upload Services from CSV or Excel
services.uploadDescription: Recognized columns: Name, Price (required), Duration, Category, Description, Active.

inventory.uploadTitle: Upload Inventory from CSV or Excel
inventory.uploadDescription: Recognized columns: Name (required), Quantity, Unit, Category, Reorder Threshold, Expiry Date, Lot Number.
